text.tspan: Existing owner roles / shared recovery DESIGN
Library owns claims, obligations, rules and dependency contracts
POO Module / Profile specialize; Scenario captures actual inputs
No new evaluator, authority service or agent harness
LLM-based AI agent
Discover Library assets and missing premises
Choose investigation, validation or repair branches
Propose alternatives; no self-issued evidence authority
Evidence arrival / REC01-REC03
Original identity, bytes, claim and method
Separate production, arrival and effective time
Exact target / required dependencies / actual authority
Raw or authentic does not automatically mean applicable
Independent method / applicability review
Archive status matches its policy boundary
Causal trace narrows compatible histories
Owner approval matches original duty and acceptance
Missing stays pending; inconsistent evidence needs review
EXISTING ASCENT relation vocabulary
Applicable + checked -> support and/or counter
Pending means no support, not no conflict
New usage/cut preserves complete T/V lineage
t_use is not actual execution or permission
EXISTING Aitia native request / verifier / stage boundary
New captured bundle -> exact current criterion requests
Genuine content receipts / intended policy / explicit now
Registered current failure is not overwritten by a new pass
New recovery scenarios are not installed or executed
REC04-REC08 / scoped recovery DESIGN
Keep original cut, opposing evidence and actual effects
Reopen affected completeness / negative dependencies
Reuse stable V/method/proof content; new A and request bindings
No old receipt transfer or unrelated blanket reruns
Qualification boundary
18 authored recovery steps / independent oracle controls
External authority/history, issuer trust and capture still need tests
Gate result does not authorize or atomically bind actual use
No implementation or performance/productivity claim
